chapter_description.p: Programmatic creation and editing of nflow block-diagram models.
NFlow is currently released as 1.0.0-beta.1: it is functional and tested, but details of its interfaces and file format may still evolve based on feedback.

keyword.name: NFlow.exportfmu
keyword.description: Export an nflow model as an FMI 3.0 Co-Simulation source FMU.

keyword.name: NFlow.plotScopes
keyword.description: Open one figure per scope of an nflow simulation result.

keyword.name: add_block
keyword.description: Add a block to an nflow model from a library source.

keyword.name: add_line
keyword.description: Connect two block ports in an nflow model.

keyword.name: bdIsDirty
keyword.description: Return true when an nflow model has unsaved changes.

keyword.name: bdIsLoaded
keyword.description: Return true when an nflow model is loaded.

keyword.name: bdclose
keyword.description: Unload one or all nflow models, discarding unsaved changes.

keyword.name: bdroot
keyword.description: Return the top-level model of a block path.

keyword.name: close_system
keyword.description: Unload an nflow model; a dirty model requires an explicit save flag.

keyword.name: delete_block
keyword.description: Delete a block and all of its connections from an nflow model.

keyword.name: delete_line
keyword.description: Delete a connection between two block ports.

keyword.name: find_system
keyword.description: List the blocks of a model, optionally filtered by type.

keyword.name: gcbh
keyword.description: Return the handle of the current block.

keyword.name: getNFlowBlockHandle
keyword.description: Return the handle of a block by path, or -1 if not found.

keyword.name: get_param
keyword.description: Query a model or block parameter.

keyword.name: getfullname
keyword.description: Return the full path of a block or model from its handle.

keyword.name: linmod
keyword.description: Numerical linearization of an nflow model.

keyword.name: load_system
keyword.description: Load an nflow model from a .nflow file without opening the editor.

keyword.name: new_system
keyword.description: Create and load an empty nflow model.

keyword.name: nflow_codegenerate
keyword.description: Generate standalone C or Rust code from an nflow model.

keyword.name: save_system
keyword.description: Save an nflow model to a .nflow file.

keyword.name: set_param
keyword.description: Set model or block parameters atomically.

keyword.name: sim
keyword.description: Run an nflow simulation of a model and return its results.

keyword.name: NFlow.sspInfo
keyword.description: Inspect, import and export SSP (System Structure and Parameterization) archives.

keyword.name: trim
keyword.description: Find a steady-state operating point of an nflow model.
